I want to visit Japan for 5 days in April, temples and gardens.

ITINERARY

DESTINATION   Kyoto and Nara
DURATION      5 days
INTENSITY     Medium

DAY 01        Higashiyama, Kiyomizu-dera at opening
DAY 02        Arashiyama, Tenryu-ji garden
DAY 03        Nara day trip, Todai-ji and the deer park
DAY 04        Northern Kyoto, Kinkaku-ji and Ryoan-ji
DAY 05        Fushimi Inari before sunrise

WHY
April is cherry season. Every one of these is unusable by mid-morning, so
the plan is built around early starts rather than around distance.
